byod_dsn_cache_serves_total.description: Decrypted-DSN cache serves, mode=fresh|stale; stale serves indicate degraded KMS operation (RFC §16.5).

byod_global_connection_ceiling_rejection.description: Tenant-connection acquisitions shed at the global ceiling → 503 retry-after (§16.9 'global ceiling reached', E7).

byod_global_connections_in_flight.description: Global tenant-connection in-flight count vs the fleet ceiling (§11 'global tenant-connection ceiling approached').

byod_kms_decrypt_errors_total.description: KMS/decrypt failures, outcome=served_cached|cold_fail (§16.9 'KMS unavailable' → serve from decrypted-DSN cache; cold tenant fails alone, RFC §16.5).

byod_metering_idempotent_replays_total.description: Metering writes deduped by idempotency key — no double-count (§16.9 'idempotency-key replay', E1).

byod_routing_integrity_violations_total.description: Connection company_id-tag assertion failures → query aborted, never served cross-tenant (§16.9 'routing/company mismatch', E5). Any non-zero value pages.

byod_tenant_db_errors_total.description: Per-tenant DB errors (timeout, connect, query) — per-tenant error-rate.

byod_tenant_pool_connections_in_use.description: Per-tenant connection-pool connections currently checked out.

byod_tenant_pool_size.description: Per-tenant connection-pool size (for saturation = in_use / size).

byod_tenant_schema_gate_total.description: Version-gated feature reads, decision=met|blocked (§16.9 'schema ahead/behind' → version-gate, never throw, RFC §8.2).

byod_tenant_schema_version.description: Tenant data-plane schema version (numeric) recorded in the control-plane registry (§8.1); drift vs engine target is the §16.9 'schema ahead/behind' signal.

byod_tenant_vector_dimension_mismatch_to.description: Wrong-dimension embedding rows skipped on read (§16.9 'wrong-dimension vectors'); tenant marked unhealthy.

sapybase_http_request_duration_seconds.description: End-to-end request latency; source for p50/p95/p99.

sapybase_http_requests_total.description: HTTP requests, partitioned by 2xx/4xx/5xx status_class — error-rate numerator/denominator.
